notes.title: Patch 1.1.5
notes.content:
Just published Patch 1.1.5.
This patch will also be available on mobile devices very soon.

In case you missed it: Invisibox is now also [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/620940/announcements/detail/1649885715946717430]available on iOS and Android[/url], for free! Go check it out :)

Patch 1.1.5 (PC) Changelog:
- Restart Button in Game Over Screen
- In-Game Mute Button
- Spikes no longer have shortened spikes at their side to make it more obvious that they're solid from the side
- Changed Level 42 slightly to fix not being able to reach 3 stars
- Changed Level 47 Star Ranks
- Changed Level 56 Star Ranks

Enjoy!

notes.title: Invisibox Mobile Release + Patch 1.1!
notes.content:
[url=http://play.invisibox.retrific.net][img]https://imgur.com/2ey5DIV.gif[/img][/url]

Greetings,
I have a big surprise for you! INVISIBOX is now available on MOBILE DEVICES!
Yes you heard right! Android and iOS! And the best thing is: You can play it for free!
The mobile version is basically just like the pc version, including all 90 levels.
There are only small differences. The biggest difference really is that the mobile version is free to play.

So if you don't own Invisibox yet or you want to have a challenging puzzling experience on the go:
You can go download Invisibox right now!

[u]Choose your version:[/u]

[url=http://invisiboxapp.retrific.net][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30835208/ce66829a9a30fb40a58aa41b676ee1c09e74d39c.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://invisiboxapp2.retrific.net][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30835208/6936f3764167a1c8c5089e827cee4dc47c271710.png[/img][/url]

[u]And there is more news:[/u]
Together with the mobile release I am also releasing a patch for the PC Version with some requested features and important improvements.
You can find the full changelog and differences between PC and mobile version below. If your steam client doesn't update automatically try restarting steam.

[u]Patch Notes Invisibox Version 1.1[/u]
[list]
[*]Simplified Tutorial
[*]Made Level 17 easier
[*]Made Level 20 harder
[*]Boxes now have a subtle idle animation before you make your first move so that you notice all individual boxes
[*]You earn Helpers now even when you used a Helper to solve the level
[*]You now start the game with zero Helpers (If you have played the game before you will still have all your Helpers)
[*]On Game Over Screen Click first fills out all stars and only when all stars are filled the click will start the next level
[*]Added Twitter Button to Main Menu
[*]Added Notifications that ask you to write a review. Write a review to stop them from showing up. (Click Yes if you have already written a Review)
[*]Increased amount of level sway
[*]Added Option to toggle level swaying animation
[*]Increased background movement
[*]Made Target Squares a bit more transparent
[*]Fixed and Improved Scaling for different Window Sizes
[*]Game now supports even more window sizes. Rescaling the window has never been more fun!
[*]Improved Mouse Menu Controls
[*]Default Helper Key is now Spacebar
[*]Fixed a whole bunch of bugs
[*]Improved Performance a lot
[/list]

[u]Mobile Version differences from PC version:[/u]
[list]
[*]The mobile version is free to play
[*]Supports landscape and portrait mode
[*]You only earn one Helper for 3 stars, zero for everything else
[*]You can use a Helper even when you don't have any left by watching a short ad
[*]Sometiems shows Ad when continuing to next (the more stars you earn the less likely it will be you get to see an ad)
[*]Sometimes shows Ad when restarting a level
[*]Added Banner Ads to some menus
[*]Doesn't have all the options the pc version has
[*]Has a lock orientation option
[*]Doesn't have the Visibox option
[*]Doesn't have a quit button
[*]No Back Button in Menus. (Swipe left/right to go back or use android back button)
[*]Has a mute button in main menu
[/list]

Good Luck!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey,
I just published Patch 1.0.2 that fixes some issues and improves some features that were requested by user feedback.

Here's the changelog:
[list]
[*] The Retrific Intro is skipable
[*] Steam Screenshot Support
[*] Level Selection automatically selects the last played level
[*] Arrow Keys now also work as input keys by default
[*] The Game Over Screen Animations can be speed up by holding down space/mouse
[*] Level 12 now needs 9 instead of 10 moves for 3 stars
[*] Level 21 now needs 13 instead of 12 moves for 3 stars
[/list]

That's it for now.

If you want continued support and updates for Invisibox make sure that the game has active players by writing steam reviews, adding steam search tags or promoting the game in other ways. To everyone already playing Invisibox: Thank you and I hope you have a great time!

notes.title: Invisibox Steam Release
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fv7Csb7.gif[/img]

Finally! You can now buy and play Invisibox via Steam!
The steam release includes great new stuff like Steam Achievements, Steam Trading Cards or Steam Cloud Support but also bring a game patch with new content and improvements. You can read the changelog below!

ːi_happyː

To celebrate the Steam Release Invisibox will launch with a generous 20% discount! So get it now, the next sale is far in the future and won't be so generous.
20% discount on this already really fairly priced game is a f*cking steal!

Now, you might think this game looks would be perfect for mobile devices, and I totally agree. That is why I want to release Invisibox on mobile devices as well, as soon as possible. But unfortunately I am just a poor indie developer without that necessary hardware and not much mobile experience. I hope that the steam release will be successful enough to fund a mobile release and localization (for iOS and Android).
If not this game will stay a PC exclusive title.

Now the Changelog for 1.0 (Changes since the initial early access release 0.9):

[list]
[*] Added more Levels, bringing the total amount to 90 Levels
[*] Added Color Blind Mode
[*] Added more Game Over Screen Stuff
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Added Star Counter
[*] Added Steam Cloud
[*] Added Visibox Mode
[*] Added New Retrific Intro
[*] Level 50+ needs 100 collected stars before getting unlocked
[*] Minor Balancing Changes
[*] Obviously fixed some bugs and tweaked some other things
[/list]

Thanks everyone! ːretrific3ːːi_smirkː
